annotations.title: Owl Quests, how to earn $OWL points

description: The Owl Quests board: the jobs that pay $OWL points, what each one pays and how often it can be claimed. Points are also earned in the Owl Arena and the Pattern Trainer. Every quest claim is checked by hand against a public link. Points have no cash value and cannot be sent, sold or swapped; the only thing they buy is a PRO Pass of 7 to 30 days.
